reviewer: Independent Codex SCI/ZHEN text reviewer; no authorship or repairs performed

objects.meaning: Examine local medium-particle motion through a transverse elastic-cord wave; propagation is not the transport of every particle along the cord.

zh.text:
要理解波的传播，就要看清介质中的各个质点怎样运动。
先从沿橡皮绳传播的横波开始，区分质点的局部振动与波沿绳的传播。

en.text:
To understand wave propagation, we need to follow individual particles of the medium.
We begin with a transverse wave traveling along an elastic cord.

objects.meaning: Mass and elasticity, cross-section elastic forces, net restoring force, inertial overshoot, deceleration and the maximum-displacement turning point are all retained.
objects.qualification: The restoring-motion description is read within the lesson's small-amplitude outgoing oscillatory-wave model, not as a law for arbitrary superpositions.

zh.text:
橡皮绳的每一小段都具有质量和弹性。
绳发生形变时，弹力通过各个截面作用于相邻绳段。
作用在绳段上的合回复力趋向于使它回到平衡位置。

由于惯性，运动中的绳段到达平衡位置时不会立即停下，而会越过这个位置。
继续偏离平衡位置时，回复力使它向外的运动逐渐减慢。
到达最大偏移处时，绳段短暂停下，随后向平衡位置返回。

en.text:
Every short segment of the cord has both mass and elasticity.
When the cord bends, elastic forces act across its cross sections.

The net restoring force tends to pull each segment toward equilibrium.
Inertia carries a moving segment past its equilibrium position.

Beyond equilibrium, the restoring force slows its outward motion.
At maximum displacement it stops briefly, then starts back.

objects.meaning: Identical metal balls suspended on strings and much lighter connecting springs separate inertia from elastic coupling without claiming complete equivalence to a continuous cord.

zh.text:
图69用一串相同的金属球组成的链子来模拟细绳。
各球悬挂在线上，相邻球之间用弹簧连接。
弹簧的质量比球的质量小得多。

因此，模型的质量主要集中在各球上。
球之间的弹性联系则主要由轻弹簧提供。
把质量和弹性这样分开，仍能说明细绳中波传播的基本机制，但不能据此认为模型与真实细绳的一切细节都相同。

en.text:
Figure 69 models the cord with a chain of identical metal balls.
The balls hang from strings and are joined by springs.
The springs have much less mass than the balls.

Most of the model's mass is concentrated in the balls.
The light springs provide elastic coupling.
This captures the basic wave mechanism, not every detail of a real cord.

objects.meaning: Figure 69 object identity and its source position are preserved.
The source's number-only Figure 69 caption is retained/localized without inventing figure description.

en.text: Figure 69

objects.meaning: Leftmost ball moves sideways in the horizontal plane; deformed spring pulls the next ball in the same transverse direction, with a delayed inertial response.
objects.qualification: Both languages explicitly limit the account to small amplitude before appreciable loss or reflection. No finite dead time for the first force response is asserted.

zh.text:
在水平面上，把最左边的球向链线的侧方移离平衡位置。
这里的侧向位移垂直于链线，对应所研究的横向运动。
连接的弹簧发生形变，弹力使第二个球也开始向同一侧运动。

第二个球具有惯性，因此它的响应不是瞬时完成的。
它的运动跟随第一个球的运动，在时间上有所滞后。
这里采用小幅运动的理想模型，并先不考虑明显损耗和反射的影响。

en.text:
Move the leftmost ball sideways in the horizontal plane.
Here, sideways means perpendicular to the chain.
The connecting spring deforms and pulls the second ball sideways.

That ball has inertia, so its response takes time.
Its motion follows the first ball's motion with a delay.
We use a small-amplitude model, before appreciable loss or reflection.

objects.meaning: Period T, hand or mechanical drive, successive second/third-ball phase lag, forced common driving frequency and outgoing transverse propagation are retained.
objects.qualification: Common frequency is after the initial transient and before reflected waves return; phase lag does not assert that every pair of balls always has distinct phase.

zh.text:
用手或机械装置使第一个球以周期 $T$ 振动。
第二个球受到弹簧的周期性作用而作受迫振动，相位比第一个球滞后。
第三个球通过下一根弹簧受到作用，振动的相位又进一步滞后。

扰动就这样沿球链逐个传递。
初始暂态过去后，受驱动的各球以驱动频率振动，而沿传播方向存在相位滞后。
在反射波尚未返回的传播区域内，这种横向振动形成沿球链前进的横波。

en.text:
Drive the first ball periodically with period $T$, by hand or a mechanism.
The second ball is forced to oscillate, with a phase delay.

Through the next spring, the third ball responds with a further delay.
The disturbance continues from ball to ball along the chain.

After the initial transient, the driven balls share the driving frequency.
Before reflected waves return, this is an outgoing transverse wave.

objects.meaning: Six overhead views at quarter-period intervals show ball positions; arrows are instantaneous velocity vectors, not displacement or wave-ray arrows.
objects.mappingScope: Mapping is verified against the source prose and declarations, not against unobserved figure labels or arrows.

zh.text:
图70的 a、b、c、d、e、f 六幅俯视图依次记录横波传播时各球的位置，相邻两幅对应的时刻相差四分之一振动周期。
各球旁的箭头表示该球在相应时刻的速度矢量，也就是运动方向和快慢。

en.text:
Figure 70 has six overhead views of the ball positions, labeled a, b, c, d, e, and f.
The views are a quarter-cycle apart, and each arrow is a ball's velocity vector.

objects.meaning: Heavy balls/light springs, axial suspension constraint, axial drive with unchanged T and compressions/rarefactions are retained; particles oscillate locally.

zh.text:
图71a所示的弹性模型由重球和连接它们的轻弹簧组成。
球的悬挂方式使它们只能沿链线振动。
沿这个方向使第一个球以周期 $T$ 振动。

纵波便沿球链传播。
球间距离交替变小和变大，形成密集和稀疏的区域。
图71b展示了这种疏密分布，而每个球仍是在自己的局部位置附近往复运动。

en.text:
Figure 71a uses heavy balls connected by light springs.
The suspension lets each ball oscillate only along the chain.
Drive the first ball with period $T$ along that same direction.

A longitudinal wave then travels along the chain.
Close and wide gaps between balls form compressions and rarefactions.
Figure 71b shows the pattern as each ball oscillates locally.

Number-only Figure 70 caption is retained/localized.

defects.exactText: A large thin plate moving normally can approximate such a wave.
defects.defect: In ordinary English, 'moving normally' primarily means moving in the usual manner. It leaves the source's oscillatory motion perpendicular to the plate implicit, even though the later sentence explicitly states the wave's normal propagation direction. This is a localized clarity defect, not a new contradictory physics claim.
defects.smallestRepair: Replace only this sentence with: A large thin plate oscillating perpendicular to its surface can approximate such a wave.
defects.proposedReplacement: A large thin plate oscillating perpendicular to its surface can approximate such a wave.
defects.repairScope: One English sentence; preserve the large plate, uniform/isotropic-medium assumptions, uniform driving, phase definition and edge-diffraction caveat.

defects.exactText: These forces drive the local oscillations.
defects.defect: The actual normalized flow splits a six-sentence shear explanation into 2/3/1. The final anaphoric mechanism sentence completes the preceding restoring-force explanation; it is neither an independent definition nor a separate contextual qualification. The source's coherent restoring-force-to-oscillation explanation therefore ends as an arbitrary singleton.

Under the already recorded 180-character/three-line grouping rule, the six complete sentences then fit as 3/3 (175 and 168 characters), leaving the restoring-force sentence and its consequence together.

objects.meaning: Cord/string/rod axial propagation is retained as a one-dimensional approximation with either axial travel direction, not a claim of only one signed direction.

zh.text:
对于细长的橡皮绳、弦或杆，可以把波沿其长度方向的传播近似看作一维传播。
波可以沿这条轴线向任一侧传播，并不只限于某一个朝向。

en.text:
Along a slender cord, string, or rod, a wave travels mainly along its length.
It can travel either way along this axis.

objects.meaning: Continuous gas/liquid/solid media and transmission through local interactions are retained; multidirectional propagation depends on source and medium.

zh.text:
气体、液体或固体连续地充满一片空间时，可以把它看作连续介质。
局部扰动能通过介质各部分之间的相互作用，向多个方向传播。
实际的传播方向和形态取决于波源与介质，局部振动依次传递的基本过程仍与前面相同。

en.text:
A gas, liquid, or solid can form a continuous medium.
A local disturbance can spread in many directions within it.
The source and medium set the pattern through local interactions.

objects.meaning: The source's transition to new propagation features is retained.

zh.text:
波在一片空间中传播，还会表现出一些新的特点。
下面从能量的扩散和波面的形状来认识这些特点。

en.text:
Propagation through a region adds some new features.
We now examine spreading and the shape of wavefronts.

objects.meaning: Outward spreading, stone-generated surface ripples in shared Figure 64, flux per unit area per second, decreasing flux/amplitude, Section 11 and spring/pendulum/local-particle energy examples are retained.
objects.qualification: Steady uniform outward spreading without added energy, fixed other conditions and small oscillations qualify amplitude-squared scaling. Water-surface ripples are not falsely called liquid-bulk spherical waves.

zh.text:
波从局部波源向外传播时，可以扩展到越来越大的区域。
图64中的石头落水所激起的环形波，直观地展示了这种扩展。
这是水面上的波，并不是水体内部的球面波。

波源送出的能量随波的传播，分布到越来越宽广的波面上。
一秒钟内通过单位面积的能量，可以用来描述能量通量的大小。
在稳定、均匀向外扩散且没有额外能量输入的情况下，离波源越远，这一通量越小。

对于同一介质、相同频率等条件下的小振幅振动，能量与振幅的平方成正比，因此通量减小时振幅也会减小。
这一关系与第11节讨论的振动能量关系相同。
它适用于相应的小振动模型，包括弹簧重物、摆锤以及介质局部质点的振动，并不是任意大幅振动都满足的定律。

en.text:
An outward-moving wave can spread over a growing region.
The circular water ripples in Figure 64 illustrate this spreading.

They are surface waves, not spherical waves inside the water.
The energy from the source is shared over a widening front.

Energy crossing unit area in one second measures energy flux.
For steady, uniform spreading with no added energy, this flux falls with distance.

With other conditions fixed, small-oscillation energy scales with amplitude squared.
This is the relation discussed in Section 11, so a falling flux means a smaller amplitude.

It applies to small oscillations of a spring mass, a pendulum, and local medium particles.

objects.meaning: Geometric spreading decreases amplitude without converting mechanical energy into internal energy; absorption is a separate mechanism.

zh.text:
几何扩散本身就能使振幅随距离减小，即使介质没有耗散也会如此。
这种减小不需要机械能因摩擦等作用而转化成内能，不能与吸收造成的衰减混为一谈。

en.text:
Geometric spreading can reduce amplitude even in a lossless medium.
This decrease needs no conversion of mechanical energy into internal energy.

objects.meaning: Ideal plane-wave exception, large driven plate, equal contact amplitude/phase, propagation normal to plate, equal-phase wavefront definition, Figure 73 and finite-edge diffraction are present.
objects.qualification: The physics is coherent in context, with explicit uniform/isotropic medium and uniform driving. The defective phrase needs natural-English disambiguation.

zh.text:
**理想平面波**没有上述几何扩散。
让大片薄板沿其法线方向振动，可以在适当条件下近似产生平面波。
这里假定介质均匀、各向同性，并且薄板各处受到一致的驱动。

与板接触的介质质点便以相同振幅和相同相位振动，扰动沿板的法线方向传播。
位于每一个平行于薄板的平面上的质点，具有相同相位。
**等相位的面叫做波面，平面波的波面是平面**（图73）。

真实薄板的大小有限，远离边缘的区域才可能近似符合这个模型。
在边缘附近，衍射会使波面弯曲，实际波并不是处处都保持理想平面波的形态。

en.text:
An **ideal plane wave** does not undergo geometric spreading.
A large thin plate moving normally can approximate such a wave.

Assume a uniform, isotropic elastic medium and uniform driving.
Points touching the plate then oscillate with equal amplitude and phase.
The wave travels normal to the plate.

Points on each plane parallel to the plate have the same phase.
An equal-phase surface is called a **wavefront**.
Plane-wave wavefronts are planes (Figure 73).

A finite plate gives only an approximation away from its edges.
Near an edge, diffraction bends the wavefronts.

objects.meaning: Figure 73 identity is preserved.
Number-only Figure 73 caption is retained/localized.

en.text: Figure 73

objects.meaning: Rays are normal to equal-phase fronts; plane-wave rays are parallel straight lines, and ray/energy propagation alignment is confined to the uniform isotropic ray model.

zh.text:
**垂直于波面的线叫做波射线**，平面波的波射线是相互平行的直线。
在这里采用的均匀、各向同性介质模型中，波射线表示波的传播方向。
在这种射线描述下，波的能量也沿波射线传播，不能把这一方向关系无条件推广到所有复杂介质。

en.text:
**A wave ray is a line normal to a wavefront.**
For a plane wave, these normals form parallel straight lines.

In a uniform, isotropic medium, rays also show the propagation direction.
In this ray description, wave energy travels along the rays.

objects.meaning: Ideal plane waves have no geometric dilution; lossless uniform amplitude is constant, while dissipation or finite-beam spreading can reduce amplitude.

zh.text:
理想平面波传播时，垂直于传播方向的横截面积不随距离增大，能量没有几何扩散。
在均匀、无耗散的介质中，它的振幅保持不变。
耗散能使振幅减小，而实际有限宽度的波束还可能在边缘扩散，因此不能把所有振幅减小都归因于摩擦。

en.text:
An ideal plane wave keeps a fixed cross-sectional area as it travels.
In a uniform lossless medium, its amplitude therefore stays constant.

Dissipation can reduce it, while real finite beams may also spread at their edges.

objects.meaning: Rod touching water and oscillating vertically produces approximately straight surface fronts, equal phase parallel to the rod away from its ends, and Figure 74.
objects.qualification: The surface-wave/plane-wave analogy is expressly not evidence of liquid-bulk shear propagation.

zh.text:
水面上的**线波**能为认识空间中的平面波提供直观类比。
让一根杆轻轻接触水面，并使杆上下振动，就能在适当条件下形成近似直线的波面。
远离杆的两端时，位于平行于杆的直线上的水面质点近似同相位振动（图74）。

这仍是液面波的波面，不能把这种类比当成液体内部传播平面剪切波的证据。

en.text:
Straight water-surface waves provide a visible analogy to plane waves.
To produce them, let a rod lightly touch the water and move it up and down.

Away from the rod ends, points on lines parallel to it have nearly equal phase (Figure 74).
These are surface wavefronts, not plane shear waves in the liquid bulk.

objects.meaning: Figure 74 identity is preserved; normalized flow pairs it with its caption.
Figure 75 identity is preserved; normalized flow pairs it with its caption.
Number-only Figure 74 caption is retained/localized.

en.text: Figure 74

objects.meaning: Number-only Figure 75 caption is retained/localized.

en.text: Figure 75

objects.meaning: Uniform pulsation in a uniform isotropic medium yields source-centered spherical equal-phase fronts and outward radial rays; Figure 75 remains referenced.

zh.text:
连续介质中的另一种例子是**球面波**，也叫球形波。
在均匀、各向同性的介质中，一个均匀脉动的球面可以向外产生球面波（图75）。
波面是以波源中心为球心的球面，波射线沿半径的延长线向外。

en.text:
A uniformly pulsating sphere can produce **spherical waves** (Figure 75).
In a uniform, isotropic medium, the outgoing wavefronts are spherical.

They are spheres centered on the source.
The rays point outward along the extensions of the radii.

objects.meaning: Steady uniform lossless outward spherical power spreads over larger spheres; flux and amplitude fall with radius at fixed medium/frequency even without absorption.
objects.qualification: No inverse-radius formula or numerical example has been added to the card. The sentence that names geometric spreading and the opening model context are valid singleton exceptions.

zh.text:
在稳定、均匀向外传播且无吸收的球面波模型中，通过各个包围波源的球面的总功率相同。
球面的半径越大，面积就越大，能量便分布在更大的面积上，单位面积的能量通量随之减小。
在介质性质、频率等条件相同时，振幅也随半径增大而减小，这是几何扩散，不要求有能量吸收。

en.text:
For steady, uniform spherical spreading without absorption, each sphere carries the same power.

Larger spheres have more area, so less energy crosses each unit of area in one second.
With the medium and frequency fixed, the amplitude decreases with radius.

This is geometric spreading, which occurs even without absorption.

objects.meaning: Transverse displacement, shear, layer shifts, no first-order volume change in small pure shear, and solid restoring forces driving local oscillations are retained.

zh.text:
在**横波**中，质点的位移方向垂直于波的传播方向。
固体内部的弹性横波涉及**切变**，也叫剪切形变，物质各层彼此相对错动。
在小形变的纯剪切模型中，体积在一阶近似下不变。

有剪切刚度的弹性固体发生这种形变时，会产生使它恢复原状的弹力。
这些恢复力使介质的各部分发生局部振动。

en.text:
In a **transverse wave**, particle displacement is perpendicular to propagation.
A transverse bulk wave in a solid involves **shear deformation**.

Layers shift relative to one another.
In the small, pure-shear model, there is no volume change to first order.
In an elastic solid, shear produces restoring forces.

These forces drive the local oscillations.

objects.meaning: Ordinary liquids/gases lack static shear stiffness and cannot carry bulk elastic shear waves in the stated model; shear-stiff solids can, with explicit footnote ①.
objects.qualification: The statement is not extended to all transverse phenomena, viscoelastic high-frequency responses or liquid-surface motion.

zh.text:
这里讨论的普通液体和气体没有静态剪切刚度，各层相对错动时没有固体那样的剪切恢复力。
因此，在这一普通流体模型中，液体和气体内部不能传播弹性剪切横波。
有剪切刚度的固体可以传播这类横波，液体表面的情况则要按脚注①另作区分。

en.text:
Here, ordinary liquids and gases have no static shear stiffness.
They cannot carry bulk elastic shear waves in this model.
Solids can carry them, with the surface qualification in ①.

objects.meaning: Footnote ① remains a separate labeled explanatory prose object. It retains the surface exception and correctly allows vertical/horizontal particle motion with gravity and surface tension restoring the surface.
objects.qualification: Neither language claims that real liquid-surface waves are necessarily pure transverse waves or that their restoring force is bulk shear elasticity.

zh.text:
① 液体表面的波可以包含上下的横向位移，质点运动也可能同时包含水平分量，并不一定是纯横波。
液面的恢复作用来自重力和表面张力，这不意味着普通液体内部具有传播弹性剪切横波所需的剪切刚度。

en.text:
① Liquid-surface waves can move particles both vertically and horizontally.
Gravity and surface tension restore the surface, not bulk shear elasticity.

objects.meaning: Longitudinal displacement, solid compression/extension, fluid compression/rarefaction, Section 37 and bulk restoring response in solids/liquids/gases are retained.
objects.qualification: Fluid propagation does not require sustained tensile stress. 'All media' means the three material-medium classes under discussion, not a vacuum.

zh.text:
**纵波**的质点位移方向沿波的传播方向，在固体中表现为压缩与拉伸形变（见第37节）。
在普通液体和气体中，它表现为压缩与稀疏，并不要求流体维持拉伸应力。
固体、液体和气体在体积受到压缩时都有相应的恢复作用，因此都能传播纵波。

en.text:
A **longitudinal wave** has displacement along propagation (Section 37).
In a solid, it involves compression and extension.

In an ordinary liquid or gas, it involves compression and rarefaction.
This does not require the fluid to sustain tensile stress.

Bulk compression produces restoring effects in all these media.
Solids, liquids, and gases can therefore carry longitudinal waves.

objects.meaning: In the usual isotropic elastic-rock model, P travels faster than S; same-earthquake P/S arrival delay can estimate source-station distance with suitable speeds and paths.
objects.qualification: This is not an unqualified claim for every anisotropic solid, every wave path or every earthquake record. A single-station delay does not uniquely locate the source.

zh.text:
在通常采用的各向同性弹性岩石模型中，纵向的P波比横向的S波传播得快。
因此，地震观测站通常先记录到P波，随后记录到同一次地震产生的S波。
两种波到达的时间差，可以用来估算震源到观测站的距离。

这种估算需要合适的P波、S波传播速度及路径模型，实际地壳并不是处处均匀的。
单个观测站的时间差可以提供距离信息，但不能独自唯一确定震源的位置。

en.text:
In the usual isotropic elastic model of rock, longitudinal P waves travel faster than transverse S waves.
A station therefore normally records P waves first.

S waves from the same earthquake arrive later.
Their arrival-time difference helps estimate the distance to the source.

The estimate requires suitable P- and S-wave speeds and a model of their paths.
One station's delay alone does not uniquely locate the source.

singletonJudgments.reason: A complete contextual caution separating the water-surface analogy from liquid-bulk shear propagation.
A complete model-scope sentence enumerating the small-oscillation contexts to which the relation applies; not a semicolon fragment.
A complete contextual qualification distinguishing lossy/finite beams from the ideal lossless plane-wave case.
Introduces the steady, uniform, no-absorption spherical-power model.
Names the described process as geometric spreading and separates it from absorption.
